name: keylang-vscode
description: Thin client for `keylang lsp`: diagnostics, hover, definition, completion, references, and code lenses for keylang specs.

keylang.command.description: Executable that runs keylang (for a checkout: `node` with `keylang.args` set to the path of bin/keylang.js and `lsp`).

keylang.args.description: Arguments for `keylang.command`; the last one must start the language server (`lsp`).
